Student Induction Program – 2023
STUDENT INDUCTION PROGRAM (SIP 23) AT DAVIET PAVES THE PATH FOR ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE AND CULTURAL ENRICHMENT
In a remarkable endeavor to shape the future leaders of tomorrow, DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET) recently hosted a transformative Induction Training Program. This unique initiative, supported by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), aims to immerse students in the region's rich tapestry of socio cultural and historical traditions while equipping them with the indispensable skill set to surmount the academic challenges that college life presents. During the Induction Training Program, the new entrants, their parents, faculty, and dignitaries performed a 'Hawana Yajna' to seek divine blessings. Chanting sacred hymns, students and faculty sought wisdom and strength for a successful academic journey, embracing spiritual values alongside academic excellence. Dr. Susheel Mittal, Vice Chancellor of I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University (IKG PTU), and the esteemed Chief Guest delivered an inspiring address. He emphasized the importance of embracing a multidisciplinary approach to education and encouraged the students to explore diverse fields of knowledge. Dr. Mittal stressed the need for continuous learning and adaptability in the fast changing world. As the Chief Guest, he motivated the new entrants to aim for excellence in their academic pursuits and to cultivate a sense of responsibility towards society. Mr. Jaspal Singh, Chief Engineer, Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana, and the esteemed Guest of Honour , delivered an insightful address. He highlighted the importance of fostering a culture of innovation and creativity among the students. He inspired the students to own the institution and gave them a 5 step formula for success viz Dream Big, be courageous, have a positive attitude, work hard, and believe in yourself. Mr. Arwind Ghai, Secretary of DAVCMC (Dayanand Anglo Vedic College Management Committee), addressed the new entrants with heartfelt words. He warmly welcomed the students to the DAV family and emphasized the institution's rich legacy of academic excellence and character building. Dr. Kanchan L Singh, Head of the Department of Applied Sciences , delivered the vote of thanks, expressing gratitude to the dignitaries, faculty, and students for their presence. The Induction Training Program at DAVIET promises to prepare the students for a successful academic journey while fostering cultural understanding and innovation.
